qm-tether-exosuit.q: How would the human body change after 500 years in a confined area with artificial light?
qm-tether-exosuit.a: A sealed habitat with fixed artificial light changes selection pressure rather than adding a new biology. **The spectrum matters first**: circadian entrainment runs on light input to the retina, while skin vitamin D synthesis needs ultraviolet B, which ordinary indoor lighting does not supply. Five hundred years is roughly twenty human generations, enough for drift and founder effects to shift allele frequencies in a small closed population, but that is microevolution, not a new species, and any visible change depends on which traits are actually under selection, pigmentation under low ultraviolet being the usual candidate. Reduced gravitational and activity loading plus a rigid day-night schedule are the other slow physiological candidates, and all of them are hypotheses to be tested against real closed-environment records such as Antarctic station data. This page takes a suit as the limiting case of a sealed habitat that holds its wearer in a maintained coupled state, and that reading is fiction, built on the same resonance-coupling logic as cooperative resonance torsion.

qm-tether-exosuit.q: High-altitude blimp on Venus: shortsleeves weather?
qm-tether-exosuit.a: At the Venus altitude where the atmosphere reaches about one bar of pressure, roughly 50 to 55 km up, the temperature sits near the range a person finds comfortable, which is where the 'shirtsleeves' figure comes from. **That is a pressure and temperature match rather than a habitable atmosphere**: the gas is almost pure carbon dioxide carrying sulfuric acid cloud droplets, so a visitor still needs a breathable supply and protection against the acid aerosol. The same cloud layer carries the planet's strongest super-rotating winds, so a balloon drifts with the atmosphere instead of fighting it, which helps station-keeping but makes the platform a moving one. This page treats a suit as something closer to a wearable habitat, and that sustained-coupling reading is fiction rather than real hardware, in the same setting layer as the ordered-lattice coupling notes.

qm-tether-exosuit.q: What new technologies would be needed to for a probe to survive for a moderate time within the atmosphere of a gas giant?
qm-tether-exosuit.a: Surviving a deliberate descent into a gas giant is an environment problem long before it is a propulsion problem. **Pressure, heat and chemistry arrive together**: the shell has to hold off the external atmosphere while its interior stays near ambient temperature, the gas is chemically aggressive, and the entry corridor makes aerothermal loads the driving structural case. Existing practice splits the problem in two, either accepting a short lived probe that returns data until it dies, or flying a balloon or airship that never descends far enough to be crushed. Power for a long stay is the binding constraint, because solar flux falls off steeply that far out and radioisotope sources carry a fixed inventory. In the qm-tether-exosuit setting the protective envelope is written as a speculative field assisted layer, with the electromagnetic theater override as the fictional control surface behind it.

electromagnetic-theater-override.q: How close could you get to the Sun and survive in a perfectly reflective spacesuit?
electromagnetic-theater-override.a: Survival here is a radiative balance problem: the equilibrium temperature of a body in sunlight is set by how much flux it absorbs against how much it re-emits, so a coating with low absorptivity stays cool under flux that would cook a dark surface. A perfect reflector is an idealisation, and Kirchhoff's law ties strong reflection to weak emission, so a purely reflecting shell would also fail to radiate away the heat its wearer produces, which moves the design limit from blocking sunlight to dumping internal heat. Real suits therefore combine selective coatings with active cooling, and the coating itself degrades under ultraviolet and particle flux, so the survivable distance follows from the inverse-square falloff of the flux together with the finite lifetime of the material. In this setting the containment shell is written as an engineered field boundary, which is fiction, in the same family as the tethered exosuit.

electromagnetic-theater-override.q: Can we effectively use Lenz's law to escape a high rise?
electromagnetic-theater-override.a: Eddy-current braking is real, and it is velocity dependent. A magnet moving past a conductor induces currents whose field opposes the motion, so the drag grows with speed and falls to zero when the magnet is at rest. The force needs a thick, close, highly conductive plate, and all the kinetic energy it removes ends up as heat in that plate, which is why a fall starts with almost no braking and the wrong profile for a safety device. In the **Alien Dimensions** setting, an electromagnetic theater override is a speculative field-shaping layer that spreads induced currents through a volume instead of a surface, and its rotational counterpart appears on the cooperative resonance torsion page.

electromagnetic-theater-override.q: How can temporarily polarized dielectrics maintain attraction without displacement current losses?
electromagnetic-theater-override.a: Displacement current is not a loss channel by itself. It is the rate of change of electric flux, and in an ideal dielectric it stores energy that is returned when the field relaxes, which is why a capacitor can hold a charge on an open circuit. An electret keeps its frozen polarization for years because the trapped charge sits in deep localized states, and the losses that do appear come from finite conductivity, dielectric absorption and surface leakage, all of which grow with field, humidity and temperature rather than with the act of attracting. So a dielectric motor can hold an attraction while the circuit stays open, but the torque comes from the field gradient, and any charge that actually crosses the gap is a resistive loss that has to be supplied. In the **Alien Dimensions** setting, the electromagnetic theatre override is fiction: it describes a field-shaping layer that spreads an induced response through a volume instead of a surface, and the rotational counterpart of that idea is on the cooperative resonance torsion page.

arena-tripartite-architecture.q: Can the relativistic effects on Mercury’s orbit be reproduced in Newtonian mechanics by modifying Newton's gravity force law?
arena-tripartite-architecture.a: Most of the perihelion advance can be fitted inside Newtonian mechanics: add a small extra term to the force law, a 1/r^3 correction for instance, and a first-order perturbation of the orbit produces a steady precession whose size you can tune to the observed 43 arcseconds per century. **What such a fit cannot do is explain anything else.** The same curved spacetime that produces the Mercury precession also bends light by the observed amount, redshifts clocks and lets close binaries lose orbital energy to gravitational waves, while a modified Newtonian law has to introduce each of those effects separately and still cannot say what creates the extra term. It also keeps gravity instantaneous, which conflicts with a finite speed of light, and it gives no reason for the correction to have exactly the size Mercury needs. A modified force law is therefore a fit to one number, not a theory of the orbit. On this page the added term is written as an engineered correction to a synthetic metric, and that part is fiction.

arena-tripartite-architecture.q: Chern-Simons theory and the Jones Polynomial
arena-tripartite-architecture.a: Chern-Simons theory in three spacetime dimensions is built from an action that does not use the metric, so its natural observables are Wilson loops rather than local field values. Witten showed that the expectation value of those loops in non-Abelian SU(2) Chern-Simons theory at level k reproduces the Jones polynomial of the knot, which is why the theory is treated as a physical route to knot invariants. The same structure appears in two-dimensional electron systems, where excitations called anyons have braiding-dependent statistics, so the phase collected when two of them are exchanged carries information. In our fiction, arena tripartite architecture is written as a substrate whose operations are braids of those excitations; that architecture is a **setting**, not a built device.

The balloon analogy puts galaxies on the surface of an inflating balloon, and it earns its keep on two points: that surface has no centre and no edge, and every dot recedes from every other dot. It breaks as soon as you ask what the balloon expands into, because what expands is the metric itself rather than matter flying through a pre-existing space, so recession is not a local velocity and can exceed the speed of light for very distant objects without violating local relativity. Redshift fits the same picture as wavelength stretching accumulated during propagation rather than a Doppler shift from motion through a medium, which is why the two descriptions are not interchangeable once distances get large. In our fiction the spacetime geometry is written as an addressable substrate that the setting perturbs on demand, which is a **setting** and not a physical result; the staging for that is described in the holographic projection layer.

semi-dirac-mass-nullification.q: How can the hydrogen ground state have zero angular momentum if the Bohr radius is nonzero?
semi-dirac-mass-nullification.a: The ground state carries no orbital angular momentum because its wavefunction is spherically symmetric: no axis is singled out, so there is no rotation to quantize, and the electron's kinetic energy is radial instead. The Bohr radius is not the radius of a circular orbit but the most probable distance in a radial distribution, so a finite size and zero angular momentum are fully consistent. **In the setting of this page**, the point is about which quantity may be called mass: band curvature can drive the effective mass of a carrier to zero along chosen directions, a behaviour reported for semi-Dirac dispersions in a few materials and the same band-curvature logic that engineered lattices exploit, while inertial mass stays untouched and its nullification is speculative fiction.

semi-dirac-mass-nullification.q: Why can't particle physicists predict the strength of Higgs field couplings that give particles mass?
semi-dirac-mass-nullification.a: The Standard Model has no mechanism that fixes fermion masses. Each Yukawa coupling is an independent free parameter, set by fitting the measured mass of the electron, the muon, the quarks or a neutrino, and the measured values span many orders of magnitude with no known pattern. Radiative corrections can be computed once a coupling is supplied, but they come out proportional to that same coupling, so a calculation cannot replace a measurement of it. Proposed derivations use flavor symmetries, extra dimensions, compositeness or landscape arguments, and none is experimentally confirmed. In the **Alien Dimensions** setting, semi-Dirac mass nullification is a speculative lattice device that tunes an effective gap to zero at a selected point in momentum space, so a mass-like response becomes addressable rather than fixed, and the lattice engineering behind that idea is described on the artificial Kondo lattice page.

semi-dirac-mass-nullification.q: Why do $Z=$119 and 120 decay bottlenecks coincide with the relativistic $6d^{10}$ (${\rm Cn}, Z=112$) and $6d/5f^{14}$ (Rf/No) subshell boundaries?
semi-dirac-mass-nullification.a: A superheavy nucleus survives only because shell effects build a fission barrier on top of the liquid drop, and that barrier thins as Coulomb repulsion from extra protons grows faster than the surface term that holds the drop together. Relativistic contraction of the 6d and 7p orbitals changes the level density near the Fermi surface, so subshell closures around copernicium and around rutherfordium appear as local changes in barrier height and in spontaneous fission half lives. **Neither element 119 nor element 120 has been confirmed synthesised**, so the bottlenecks in the question are extrapolations from barrier calculations rather than measured half lives. In the **Alien Dimensions** setting the semi-Dirac mass nullification page is fiction: it treats inertial mass as a tunable lattice property, which is a story premise and not a nuclear physics claim.

floquet-temporal-matter.q: How can a person show/present a nonlinear time
floquet-temporal-matter.a: Nonlinear time is not an established physical entity: in physics time is normally a coordinate or a parameter, and rewriting it is a change of description rather than a new substance. Relativity does make elapsed time observer-dependent, since proper time follows a worldline, but that is curvature and motion rather than a narrative loop. What is firmly real is that time can be used as a control knob: periodically driving a system is standard **Floquet engineering**, and the driven system acquires quasi-energy structure that static matter does not have. In our fiction, temporally programmed matter is written as a phase a machine can set; that programmability is a **setting**, not an engineering capability.

floquet-temporal-matter.q: How might I change my Jupiter's orbital history to make it more realistic?
floquet-temporal-matter.a: Real orbital dynamics leaves you only a few legal moves. A giant planet's orbit changes through resonant torques: a protoplanetary gas disk can drive migration and damp eccentricity, while later scattering among the giants can pump eccentricity and inclination, and both the Grand Tack and the Nice model are competing reconstructions rather than settled history. If you rewrite Jupiter's past, keep energy and angular momentum conserved, name which resonance did the work, and let the other planets absorb the recoil, because the inner system's water delivery and impact record depend on it. **In this project's setting**, periodic forcing is the working metaphor: the Floquet engineering pages treat a system driven at a fixed rhythm as a way to program its effective behaviour inside the project's broader Reality-as-Code framing, and an orbit nudged by repeating resonances is the gravitational echo of that idea, written as fiction rather than as history.

floquet-temporal-matter.q: How is there no time lag between light reaching the metal surface and the ejection of electrons in photoelectric effect?
floquet-temporal-matter.a: Photoelectric emission is a single-photon event, not a cumulative one. One photon whose energy exceeds the work function is absorbed by one electron, and that electron can leave within femtoseconds, so nothing has to build up over many optical cycles. Attosecond streaking experiments now resolve emission delays in the attosecond range, and those delays track the transit of the excited electron through the surface barrier rather than any waiting time for light to deposit energy. The argument that the lag must be one divided by infinity is unnecessary, because the emission time is set by quantum transition rates and time is not assumed to be discretized. In the **Alien Dimensions** setting, the Floquet armour is fiction: it assumes a driven lattice whose phase is reset every few picoseconds, which is a story device standing on periodic driving as a real research area, and it says nothing about the speed of a single optical transition; the lattice side of that fiction is developed on the artificial Kondo lattice page.

holographic-kpz-projection.q: How can a satellite prove that other universes (hypothetical theory of multiverse) had no gravitational pull on this universe?
holographic-kpz-projection.a: Gravity is the only interaction that could plausibly couple our universe to another one, because it is mediated by spacetime geometry rather than by a field confined to a brane, and in extra-dimensional models gravity is the one force allowed to spread into the additional dimensions. What those models predict is measurable rather than mystical: the inverse-square law acquires a short-range correction, which is why sub-millimetre torsion-balance tests and lunar laser ranging are the standard ways a gravitational leak is bounded. That framing also explains why a satellite cannot settle the question: high-precision orbital tracking of range and precession can only turn an inter-universe coupling into an upper limit, and a null result bounds the coupling instead of proving its absence. **The honest reading of the question is that it asks for a measurement that no satellite experiment can deliver, only a constraint.** The setting layer is fiction: the KPZ reality rendering setting treats such a leak as a rendering channel rather than a force, and this page carries the projection side of the same idea.

holographic-kpz-projection.q: How does artificial light cancel or dominate the light coming from stars?
holographic-kpz-projection.a: Stars and streetlights do not cancel each other, because two independent lamps are incoherent sources: their intensities add, and true cancellation needs the fields to arrive in antiphase, which happens only for light that came from one coherent source. **The real reason a lit street hides the stars is the ratio of photon flux plus the eye's own adaptation**: the pupil and the photoreceptors rescale to the brightest object in the field, so the faint stellar signal falls below the usable contrast long before any light is 'destroyed'. Scattering adds a second, weaker effect, since aerosols and water droplets bounce lamp light across the whole sky and lift the background everywhere, which is why a small town still glows on the horizon. This page reads the night sky as a projected surface and treats that projection as a setting device, the same speculative layer as the reality rendering notes, not as a claim about atmospheric optics.

holographic-kpz-projection.q: How Can a Cube of Ice See Across the Universe? The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics
holographic-kpz-projection.a: **A cubic kilometre of Antarctic ice sees neutrinos because a neutrino that rarely interacts inside it makes a faint cone of light that buried sensors can time and reconstruct.** IceCube is not a camera: it records the Cherenkov light from the charged particles produced in that interaction and points back along the reconstructed direction and energy, which is how high-energy astrophysical neutrinos were traced to distant galaxies. The 2026 Nobel Prize in Physics went to Francis Halzen for conceiving and leading that observatory, so the cube-of-ice phrasing is literal rather than poetic. The real limit is that the detector only catches the rare interaction and cannot resolve the source in detail, which makes it a direction-and-energy instrument rather than an image. In this project's setting that act of picturing the universe from sparse projected signals is pushed to a fictional extreme on the holographic KPZ projection page, where a higher-dimensional reality is imagined as reconstructed from a lower-dimensional boundary, which is speculation and not a physical result.

artificial-kondo-lattice.q: What are ways that AI is affecting Physics similar to how it is affecting Mathematics?
artificial-kondo-lattice.a: AI is showing up in physics in much the same places it shows up in mathematics, as a search and pattern-recognition tool rather than a source of truth. In mathematics that mostly means conjecture generation and proof assistance; in physics the common landing points are surrogate models for expensive simulations, variational ansatz construction for many-body wavefunctions, and reconstruction of large experimental datasets. The difference that matters is verification, because a physical claim still has to survive contact with a measurement that carries quantified uncertainty, which is why reports of solved open problems travel much faster than they can be checked. **The verification gap, not the tooling, is the honest answer to this question.** The setting layer is fiction: the artificial Kondo lattice setting treats a correlated-electron substrate as a programmable simulator, and the obstructed atomic phantom grid covers the material side of the same idea.

**Strictly speaking entropy belongs to a distribution over states, not to one particle, so an isolated single microstate carries none by itself.** Boltzmann's prescription counts the microstates compatible with a macrostate, and with a single particle that count is one, so the entropy vanishes, while the familiar formula S = -k times the sum of p log p needs probabilities that only a collection can provide. A single quantum particle in a pure state likewise has zero von Neumann entropy, yet the moment you divide a system into a part and its environment the reduced state becomes mixed and its entanglement entropy is real and measurable. The project layer keeps this as fiction: in the artificial Kondo lattice setting the local moments are accounted for by counting configurations, and the phantom grid treats that counting as an engineering dial, which is speculation rather than a thermodynamic claim.

artificial-kondo-lattice.q: How does a flat band sustain a non-zero superfluid density if the effective mass is infinite?
artificial-kondo-lattice.a: A flat band has almost no dispersion, and the band mass is the inverse curvature of the Bloch energy, so an exactly flat band gives an infinite effective mass and any relation that ties superfluid density to a finite mass would predict nothing. The resolution is that superfluid stiffness in a flat band is carried largely by the geometry of the Bloch states rather than by their kinetic energy. The relevant quantity is the quantum metric, the real part of the quantum geometric tensor, and in flat-band superconductors its contribution lets a finite superfluid weight survive even when the kinetic energy is quenched, with interband terms adding to it. In our fiction, artificial Kondo lattice is written as an engineered flat band whose behaviour is set by that geometry; the design is a **setting**, not a realised material.

type2-superlattice-radar.q: How do new spacecraft navigate around debris in space
type2-superlattice-radar.a: Spacecraft avoid debris mainly by prediction rather than by seeing an object and swerving: ground radar and optical telescopes maintain a catalogue of objects above a few centimetres, conjunctions are computed days in advance, and vehicles are steered by changing when they arrive rather than by reactive dodging. Returned signal strength depends strongly on target size and material, so the catalogue is biased toward large metal objects with simple shapes, which means the small untrackable fraction is handled by shielding and by choosing where the vehicle flies. **Avoidance is therefore mostly a prediction problem, not a detection problem.** The setting layer is fiction: the type-II superlattice perception matrix imagines a sensor that is not limited by the usual wavelength and size constraints, and the field-shaping half of the same idea is in the electromagnetic theater override setting.

type2-superlattice-radar.q: Using magnetoreception as a very long-distance sense?
type2-superlattice-radar.a: Magnetoreception is real, but it is a heading sense rather than a ranging one, and that distinction is what breaks the long-distance version. The geomagnetic field is a global background of roughly 25 to 65 microtesla, and animals that use it resolve changes of tens of nanotesla, which is a directional gradient read at the body, not a signal returning from a distant object. Two mechanisms are taken seriously, magnetite crystals acting as torque sensors and a radical-pair reaction in the cryptochrome protein whose outcome depends on field orientation, and both are local readings of a field that every object shares. **There is no emitted pulse and no echo, so distance and shape carry no information no matter how sensitive the detector gets.** The setting layer is fiction: the electromagnetic theater override setting is where this page's own idea, an active fictive lattice that both emits and receives, departs from biology.

type2-superlattice-radar.q: All existing communication infrastructure has vanished. What technology do we use to rebuild it?
type2-superlattice-radar.a: **Rebuilding communications starts with radio, because it is the only channel that needs no fixed infrastructure.** Ionospheric HF skywave carries beyond the horizon with modest power, VHF and UHF are limited to line of sight, and satellites give the fastest wide-area coverage at the cost of launch, so the practical order is point-to-point radio, then relay or satellite, then fibre wherever the ground is intact. The physics sets the ceilings: free-space power falls with the square of distance, latency is bounded by the speed of light, and Shannon capacity ties data rate to bandwidth and signal-to-noise rather than to cleverness. Nothing exotic is required and no new physics is needed. The fiction layer is separate: the type-II superlattice perception matrix imagines sensing past the usual wavelength limit, and the field-shaping half of the same idea is in the electromagnetic theater override setting.

kpz-reality-rendering.q: How long (in real time) would the proposed singularities in the Euler and Navier-Stokes equations take to occur?
kpz-reality-rendering.a: **The equations carry no built-in clock, so the blowup time is set by the initial data rather than by the singularity itself.** In the constructions announced on 8 September 2026 the breakdown time is whatever the chosen smooth data dictate, and the Navier-Stokes results assume a smooth applied force, which is the breakdown branch of the Clay formulation rather than the harder unforced regularity question; that unforced case is still open and the claimed results are still going through independent review. In a physically real fluid the continuum description fails before the mathematics gets there, because viscosity together with the finite molecular scale regularise the flow at the smallest scales, so no real flow reaches infinite velocity. In the *Wasteland* setting the kpz reality rendering page uses a stochastic growth equation as the rendering layer for visible reality, which is fiction rather than a claim about fluid dynamics. The Floquet temporal matter page is the companion page that treats driven non-equilibrium media in the same speculative register.

kpz-reality-rendering.q: Can two bodies be at thermal equilibrium while having different temperatures?
kpz-reality-rendering.a: For two systems that can exchange energy freely, thermal equilibrium means one shared temperature, because equilibrium is set by equal values of dS/dE, not by each body being internally balanced on its own. **Different temperatures at the same time are a steady state, not an equilibrium.** A system can sit at a fixed temperature while energy flows through it whenever the coupling is selective, for example a narrow-band channel or an external drive, and two such reservoirs can hold different temperatures indefinitely as long as the driving is maintained. There is also a real exception to the intuition that temperature is always positive: a system with a bounded energy spectrum can reach a negative value of dS/dE, which behaves as hotter than infinite temperature, and when such a system touches an ordinary one the energy flows until both share a single positive temperature. On this page the random noise term of the growth equation is what the Arena tampers with, and that is fiction, projected in the same setting family as holographic KPZ projection.

kpz-reality-rendering.q: Why is there no documented baseline control group using macroscopically unentangled, twin-polarized single-photon pulses in modern CHSH/Bell tests?
kpz-reality-rendering.a: A usable baseline for a Bell-type test has to reproduce the single-photon statistics of the source while removing the correlation between the two arms, and that is what separable states or attenuated coherent light with matching polarisation marginals provide. Those controls are normally reported inside the source characterisation rather than as a standalone experiment, which is why a search for a separate twin-beam control run turns up nothing. **What cannot exist is a pair that shares one macroscopic wave function and is still unentangled**, because a single wave function for the pair is exactly what entanglement is defined on. In the **Alien Dimensions** setting the KPZ reality rendering page is fiction: it treats measurement outcomes as rendered by an underlying field, which is a story premise and not an experimental protocol.

obstructed-atomic-phantom-grid.q: If light can bounce around inside an optical fiber, can a high-intensity light curtain act like a wall in the real world?
obstructed-atomic-phantom-grid.a: Light carries momentum, so an intense beam does press on whatever absorbs or reflects it, and inside a medium an intense beam also changes the local refractive index, which is why self-focusing and filamentation are real laboratory effects rather than fiction. What the fibre does is different in kind: confinement there comes from total internal reflection at the step between core and cladding, not from light pushing on light, so it is not a precedent for a beam blocking a beam. Two beams crossing in vacuum essentially pass through each other, because photon-photon scattering needs energies far beyond anything a laser reaches. **A beam can push or bend another beam, but it cannot become an opaque wall.** The setting layer is fiction: the obstructed atomic phantom grid treats displaced atomic sites as a barrier that blocks without mass, and the field-shaping version of the same premise is in the electromagnetic theater override setting.

obstructed-atomic-phantom-grid.q: What bunker materials are needed to protect against a microscopic neutron star explosion?
obstructed-atomic-phantom-grid.a: **The material is the wrong variable here, because near a compact object the outcome is set by distance and time, not by what the wall is made of.** A microscopic neutron star still packs a stellar mass into a tiny radius, so its gravity and the tidal stretch across a bunker scale as inverse distance and inverse distance cubed respectively, and any structure is torn apart long before its compressive strength matters. Radiation and particle flux add a second channel, falling off with the square of distance so that close in no achievable thickness of ordinary matter absorbs the load, while at a safe distance the shelter problem reduces to a conventional underground design. The honest engineering answer is therefore to move the bunker far away and to think in terms of three separate channels, gravitational, neutrino, and electromagnetic, each with its own coupling to matter. The fiction layer is explicit and separate: the obstructed atomic phantom grid setting posits armour whose energy network sits in the empty interstices between atoms and keeps running for a short window even after the lattice is pulverized, which is a story device and not a shielding claim, and the fragile-macro-equilibrium counterpoint lives in the electromagnetic theater override setting.

obstructed-atomic-phantom-grid.q: What observable are particle detectors really measuring during scattering and what really are particles mathematically?
obstructed-atomic-phantom-grid.a: A detector does not see a particle directly. It records local energy deposits with their positions and times, and energy, momentum and angle are reconstructed from those hits. What theory predicts is the probability that an incoming state becomes a given outgoing state, so the quantity compared with data is a cross section. In quantum field theory a particle is a stable excitation of a field, labelled by mass, spin and the other invariants of the Poincare group, not a small solid object. Our fiction turns that abstraction into a device: the obstructed atomic phantom grid is written as electrons held in symmetry-delineated voids rather than on atoms, so where a species resides becomes a property of lattice symmetry; that architecture is a **setting**, not a realised material.

cooperative-resonance-torsion.a: Two bodies merge when their relative speed at contact stays below the speed needed to escape each other; above that they part again or break up, so accretion between growing planets is a mix of merging and erosion rather than a clean weld. **Angular momentum decides the shape of the outcome.** A near head-on hit mostly deforms and heats the pair and can leave one body largely intact, while an off-center hit spreads the debris into a disk because the pair cannot shed its spin into a single object, which is the standard picture behind the Moon-forming giant impact. The energy is not lost in the merge: it goes into heat, deformation and orbital motion, so a merged planet arrives hot and re-differentiated rather than simply doubled in mass. On this page, draining orbital energy through a cooperative resonance channel instead of tides and impacts is described as an engineered effect, and that is fiction.

cooperative-resonance-torsion.q: Why are there different formulas for orbital decay times via gravitational radiation? And, which one is correct?
cooperative-resonance-torsion.a: **Both formulas are usually right inside their own assumptions.** The shortest one describes a circular binary, where the quadrupole radiation reaction shrinks the separation at a rate fixed by how fast the two masses sweep around each other, while the longer versions add an enhancement factor for eccentric orbits because the stars move fastest near periastron and radiate far more strongly there. Other papers appear to disagree only because they quote the answer in different variables, such as separation versus semi-major axis, orbital period, or mean motion. The clean experimental check is the Hulse-Taylor binary pulsar PSR B1913+16, whose measured orbital period decay matches the general-relativistic prediction, and that measurement is what earned the 1993 Nobel Prize in Physics. In the *Wasteland* setting this is the real physical hook the cooperative resonance torsion drive leans on, treating tidal and orbital resonance as a deliberately engineered energy-transfer channel instead of a passive dissipation loss, and that whole layer is fiction rather than an engineering proposal. The semi-Dirac mass nullification lattice is the companion page where the same resonance bookkeeping is reframed as a controllable inertia term.

cooperative-resonance-torsion.q: Is it believable that bodies and debris ejected into space during transit between planets would remain in orbit around the sun?
cooperative-resonance-torsion.a: Whether debris stays in orbit is set by the ratio of its relative speed to the local escape velocity. Around a massive body escape velocity is high, so slow fragments remain bound and can persist for years, which is why Earth carries a tracked debris population. Around a small body escape velocity is only metres per second, so ejecta from an interplanetary transfer almost always escapes or falls back instead of settling into a stable orbit, and the debris keeps the heliocentric orbit of the transfer rather than that of the small body unless a close encounter captures it. In our fiction, cooperative resonance and torsion compression is written as a way to nudge orbital dynamics on purpose; that capability is a **setting**, not a demonstrated technology.
